9. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant indicated that digital channels have reduced banking costs by 20-30% and increased sales by 10-20%.

12. [USER] User requested more information on how digital lending platforms are being used and the benefits they bring to banks and customers.
13. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained how digital lending platforms work, including the application process, data collection, risk assessment, loan decisioning, documentation, and disbursal.
14. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed benefits to banks, including increased efficiency, improved accuracy, enhanced customer experience, increased loan volume, and reduced costs.
15. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed benefits to customers, including faster loan processing, convenience, transparency, personalization, and increased accessibility.
